# embedding-cache

> SQLite disk cache for embeddings keyed by content hash, model id and dimension, with batched misses, bit-exact float64 storage and LRU eviction Python package `trysac-embedding-cache`, import name `embedding_cache`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
